posts.text: Jadea, a member of Team Murphy, honors her husband, a U.S. Marine Corps veteran who served as an infantry mortarman at the rank of Corporal and was stationed at Camp Lejeune. We are grateful for his service and continued dedication to our nation. Semper Fi! https://t.co/w29IiHw8CN

Katonya, a member of Team Murphy, honors her father, who served in the United States military during the Vietnam War. We are grateful for his service and sacrifice to our nation. https://t.co/t3J1RSPA12

April, a member of Team Murphy, honors her father, who served in the United States Air Force as a Military Police officer at Lackland Air Force Base in Texas. We are grateful for his service and sacrifice to our nation. https://t.co/j7DzCbjUvQ

I want to take a moment to recognize the military families across Team Murphy. We are proud to have staff members and family members who have served our nation. Their service, sacrifice, and continued commitment deserve our gratitude and recognition. Thank you for all you have

Ray is a 26-year U.S. Marine Corps veteran who retired as a Colonel after serving in numerous leadership and operational roles, including a deployment to Iraq in 2007. Thank you for your distinguished service and dedication to our nation. Semper Fi! https://t.co/ecAgfHNLES
https://t.co/3FRRIgCXwB

Happy Veterans Day to my staffer, Mallory, a 10-year U.S. Marine Corps veteran who served in Operation Enduring Freedom as a radio operator and was stationed at Camp Lejeune. Thank you for your service and sacrifice to our nation. Semper Fi! https://t.co/aT6iUi2Z9q

This Veterans Day, we recognize and thank the military staff and family members of Team Murphy who have served our nation. We are grateful for their sacrifice, dedication, and continued commitment to our country. Their service does not go unnoticed. Happy Veterans Day!

This Veterans Day, I am proud to recognize Major James Capers Jr., a decorated Marine and Medal of Honor recipient whose courage and sacrifice embody the very best of our nation.

Helping secure this long-overdue recognition has been one of my top priorities since coming to Congress. Eastern North Carolina is proud to call him one of our own!

This Veterans Day, we honor the brave men and women who have worn our nation's uniform and defended the freedoms we hold dear. Their courage, sacrifice, and dedication deserve our gratitude not just today, but every day. I am proud to represent the many veterans who call Eastern https://t.co/RgcLCALTCd

Happy 251st Birthday to the United States Marine Corps! For 251 years, Marines have answered the call to defend our nation with courage and unwavering commitment. As Camp Lejeune's representative, I am especially proud to recognize the Marines who serve and sacrifice for our https://t.co/EDK1cYpJk0

Too many Americans are paying more for health insurance while facing more barriers to care. 

Families across ENC are frustrated by rising premiums, high deductibles, and insurance companies that too often put profits above patients.

I will never stop fighting greedy insurers! https://t.co/CudaZtaenr

It was a pleasure to visit Hyster-Yale to meet with employees and discuss how Congress can support Eastern North Carolina manufacturing jobs, strengthen our industrial base, and keep our local economy competitive. https://t.co/b8AzOPdVTa

My 6th Veterans History Project event was a success! It is an honor to hear our veterans share their stories and to help preserve the stories of their service and sacrifice in the Library of Congress for future generations. https://t.co/zdrCujXSjC

Early Voting is underway in North Carolina through October 31. Make your voice heard!

Find your Early Voting location on the NC State Board of Elections website.
https://t.co/itIbIammbh

I enjoyed stopping by Avient Protective Materials in Greenville to meet with employees and discuss strengthening American manufacturing and producing critical ballistic armor materials here at home. https://t.co/S7Tt39maFG

In case you missed it, @WaysandMeansGOP held a hearing earlier this year on the impact of rising health care costs on patients and families.

We need serious reform of health insurers who put profits above patients. https://t.co/hLhNXwqbvQ

Nutrition plays a critical role in managing conditions like diabetes, heart disease, and high blood pressure. We should make healthy food more accessible and affordable to seniors!

Read my latest in @TheHillOpinion

https://t.co/cMWAaoDo7A

Thank you to Jones County Sheriff Matt Wineman for having me by the station. I appreciate the work you and your team do, and sacrifices you make, to keep our community safe.

I will always support our law enforcement officers in Washington! https://t.co/AOr1syvzfa

I enjoyed joining the Ayden Chamber of Commerce for lunch to discuss what’s happening in Washington and how my work in Congress affects Eastern North Carolina. Thank you to the Chamber for the opportunity to connect with local business and community leaders! https://t.co/LjpgbUVhGY

I was glad to spend time with the volunteers at NC Support Our Troops in Ayden, packing care packages for our service members. I’m grateful to everyone who gives their time to remind our troops that Eastern North Carolina stands behind them.

God bless our troops! https://t.co/T7LpQUpxWF

I was honored to attend the Beirut Memorial remembrance honoring the 273 U.S. service members killed during the peacekeeping missions in Lebanon and Grenada, including the 241 Americans killed in the October 23, 1983, terrorist attack in Beirut.

We will never forget their https://t.co/XBCeQK6ZWG

I was proud to introduce the Veterans PTSD Screening Act, bipartisan legislation directing the VA to study how RNA sequencing could help diagnose PTSD in veterans.

We owe it to those who served our country to advance innovative approaches to identifying and treating the

I was glad to join local leaders in Trenton for the groundbreaking of the new Jones County Public Works Facility. This investment will support the dedicated public works employees who keep our roads and infrastructure running. 

I look forward to seeing this project come to life! https://t.co/ICkzN24vAf

The 5th Annual WATERS Summit in Greenville continues to be a great success! @RepDavidRouzer and I led this bipartisan effort to bring stakeholders together to discuss solutions to flooding and waterway challenges across North Carolina. 

We must keep working together to protect our communities and strengthen our state’s resilience.

Great to join @pmanonair on Talk of the Town this morning as I kick off my Fifth Annual WATERS Summit to discuss flood mitigation nand waterway challenges in North Carolina!

Looking forward to a great day convening experts from across the state and country. https://t.co/PIARfsx68a

Calling all student innovators in NC-03!

@CongressionalAC
  is a great opportunity for middle and high school students to use their creativity and coding skills to build an app that addresses a problem they care about.

I encourage students across Eastern NC to participate and https://t.co/CZ0oWTj6BG

More than 17 veterans die by suicide each day. Many are battling the lasting effects of traumatic brain injuries (TBI) and PTSD.

Hyperbaric oxygen therapy (HBOT) offers a potential treatment option to help veterans recover. My bipartisan Veterans National Traumatic Brain Injury https://t.co/9JFA9zb7zr

October is Breast Cancer Awareness Month. Early detection and regular screenings can make a meaningful difference in breast cancer outcomes. I encourage everyone to talk with their doctor about their risk and recommended screenings. Together, we can raise awareness and support https://t.co/0FhO3vKhL8

A mandatory evacuation order remains in effect for visitors on Hatteras Island. If you have not evacuated, leave now before conditions deteriorate and NC-12 becomes unsafe for travel.

Monitor the latest NWS Newport/Morehead City briefing and follow local emergency officials for updates.

Stay safe and take this seriously. 

For important updates and resources: text DareEmergencyAlerts to 77295 to receive emergency alerts from Dare County.

Health insurance companies should work for patients, not stand in the way of their care. As a physician, I’ve seen how insurance denials can delay treatment and put patients in difficult positions. Our health insurance system needs serious reform that puts patients first and ensures Americans can access the care their doctors recommend. https://t.co/2ACcXO6f8p

For decades, service members, military families, and civilian workers at Camp Lejeune were exposed to contaminated drinking water. They deserve justice, not more delays.

I will keep fighting until these families get the justice they deserve.

I’m encouraged to hear that @Pontifex surgery was successful and that he is recovering well. Given my background, I know how important it is to see positive progress after surgery. I’m keeping the Holy Father in my prayers and wishing him a full and speedy recovery.
Prayers for the Holy Father Pope Leo @Pontifex as he undergoes surgery for a lung nodule. Pray it is benign. https://t.co/9KBgIgVIeI

Team Murphy was proud to host our annual Service Academy Day in New Bern this past weekend.

It was a great opportunity to meet with students and families interested in attending one of our nation’s service academies and to learn more about the application and nomination process.

Thank you to everyone who joined us!

I’m saddened to hear of the passing of Mike Ditka, a Hall of Fame player and legendary coach who led the Chicago Bears to a Super Bowl XX victory. His leadership and passion for the game made him one of football’s most iconic figures. My thoughts and prayers are with his family and loved ones.

SAVE THE DATE: Rep. Greg Murphy and Rep. David Rouzer will host the fifth annual WATERS Summit on Wednesday, October 21, in Greenville, NC.

The summit will bring together stakeholders to discuss innovative solutions to flooding and waterway challenges across North Carolina.

https://t.co/6rlyYaYlKN
Trying every day to reform it. https://t.co/gay52NsWHU

It was a pleasure to join the University City Kiwanis Club in Greenville to share an update on the latest happenings in Congress and discuss issues affecting Eastern North Carolina.

Thank you to the Kiwanis Club for having me and for the opportunity to speak with your members. https://t.co/2qY4wmSiES

My 90 yo Mother in Law had a Transient Ischemic Attack two weeks ago. Went to hospital and was kept overnight. Fortunately no deficits. It took less than a week for her to receive a denial letter from @UHC for her stay. THIS is the problem. #ProfitsAbovePatients

I am deeply saddened by the loss of Capt. Garrett Pearson, a Marine who tragically died during a training accident in Florida.

My prayers are with his wife, Autumn, their children, and Capt. Pearson’s fellow Marines during this difficult time.

We are grateful for his service and sacrifice to our nation.

This National Primary Care Physician Week, I’m proud to recognize the physicians and health care professionals who serve as the first line of care for patients and families across Eastern North Carolina.

Primary care physicians build lasting relationships with their patients, help manage chronic conditions, and keep our communities healthy. Thank you for all you do to care for your patients and our communities.

I was honored to help open the Belhaven ICW Festival from the historic River Forest Manor. Nearly a century after the completion of the Alligator-Pungo Canal, the Intracoastal Waterway remains vital to Eastern NC’s communities, businesses, tourism, and maritime economy. https://t.co/3Lk7zOsQS4

I had the pleasure of touring Minges Bottling in Ayden and seeing firsthand the hard work that goes into keeping a North Carolina business running and serving communities across Eastern NC. https://t.co/eE2rEaid0R

Anyone who thinks AI is better than a physician has never treated a patient or been a patient with a challenging diagnosis. It can assist in management but the ART of being a physician will never be replaced by a Bot.

I had the pleasure of participating in the Better Skills, Better Jobs Career Fair Kickoff Breakfast in Greenville.   Connecting Eastern North Carolinians with the skills, training, and opportunities they need to build a strong career is critical to our region’s future. https://t.co/X5H1r0JdY7

Great news! @NCDOT announced that Highway 12 on Pea Island will open to northbound traffic ahead of schedule at 3 pm today.

Again, a special thank you to our local officials in Dare County, state officials, and crews on the ground working hard to reopen the road as quickly as possible.

Visit https://t.co/YlmNerxQN3 for live updates on the status of the highway.

Violence of any kind is unacceptable in Greenville and there must be zero tolerance for individuals who threaten innocent lives. Thank you to our incredible first responders for protecting our community and saving lives. I remain committed to ensuring our police officers have the resources they need to effectively deter crime and keep our streets safe for everyone, including families, students and businesses.

Since the beginning of the Nor’easter my office has been in touch with county and state officials and has been closely monitoring restoration efforts on Highway 12. I continue to receive briefings from state and local officials on its status.

While traffic is backed up and preventing many from traveling, it is vitally important that everyone work together during this critical time. Emergency services must be able to reach those in need of medical attention quickly.

conflicts.caption: These are overlaps in public records, not evidence of a deal. Lobbying can be for or against a bill, and donors' employers didn't necessarily give money.
conflicts.method: Each itemized donor dollar is counted once, under the industry of the donor's self-reported employer; an industry counts if at least one LD-2 client in it lobbied on any bill this member sponsored or voted on.
